sections.heading: Your tutorial gear
sections.body: Attuning your first Essence granted a Tutorial Chest. It is intentionally weaker than normal crafted gear, but strong enough to begin Lumo Ruins.

sections.heading: What to do
sections.body: Open the Equipment tab in Inventory and equip the Tutorial Chest to complete First Steps.

sections.heading: Next step
sections.body: Once the Tutorial Chest is equipped, begin an expedition in Lumo Ruins to complete First Steps and unlock normal Shenic combat.
